# Indian Eagle

> > Indian Eagle is a travel booking platform specializing in cheap flights between the United States and India, offering discounted airfare, airline deals, and international route options.

Indian Eagle focuses on US-India flight routes connecting major cities like San Francisco (SFO), Houston (IAH), Mumbai (BOM), Delhi (DEL), Bengaluru, Pune, and Hyderabad. The platform provides flight search, booking services across multiple airlines, and special discounts for students, groups, and holiday travelers.

## Key Topics

- US-India flights
- Cheap flights and airfare deals
- International flight booking
- Major Indian cities: Delhi (DEL), Mumbai (BOM), Bengaluru, Pune, Hyderabad
- Major US cities: San Francisco (SFO), Houston (IAH), New York, Baltimore
- Airline deals and discounts
- Student and group travel discounts
- Flight search and booking
- International routes
- Seasonal fare trends
- Trivandrum, Ahmedabad, Kochi, Goa, Amritsar destinations

## Flight Search & Deals

- [Get Cheap Flights with Real Fare Drop Insights](https://www.indianeagle.com/cheap-flights): Main cheap flights search with fare drop insights and seasonal trends
- [Discover Amazing Deals: Get the Best Flight Discounts](https://www.indianeagle.com/flights/discounts): Flight discounts hub for student, group & holiday travel deals
